SELECT MAX(T1.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)`) 
FROM frpm AS T1 
JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.`School Code` = T2.cds 
WHERE T2.AvgScrMath > 0.3

SELECT T2.School, T2.DOCType 
FROM frpm AS T1 
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.`School Code` = T2.CDSCode 
WHERE T1.`School Type` = 'Local' AND (T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > (SELECT AVG(T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) FROM frpm WHERE `School Type` = 'Local')

SELECT DISTINCT T2.NCESSchool 
FROM satscores AS T1 
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode 
WHERE T2.County = 'Alameda' AND T1.cds IN ('1751010130583', '1612910137588', '1611760134270') 
ORDER BY T1.enroll12 DESC 
LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(SUM(NumTstTakr) / COUNT(CDSCode), 2) AS AvgSATTakers
FROM satscores
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
WHERE schools.CharterNum = '756' AND schools.MailCity = 'San Diego';

SELECT `School Name`, `Low Grade` 
FROM schools 
WHERE `NCESDist` = '0613360' 
  AND `StatusType` = 'Operating' 
  AND `Magnet` = 0 
  AND `Charter` NOT IN (0, 1) 
  AND `Latitude` IS NOT NULL 
  AND `Longitude` IS NOT NULL 
  AND `Enrollment (K-12)` > 0 
  AND `NumTstTakr` = 0 
ORDER BY `Low Grade`, `School Name`

SELECT DISTINCT `School Name`, `City` 
FROM frpm 
JOIN schools ON frpm.`School Code` = schools.CDSCode 
WHERE `Educational Option Type` = 'HS' AND `NSLP Provision Status` = 'Provision 2' AND `Low Grade` < '9'
ORDER BY `School Name`;
SELECT MIN(`Low Grade`) AS LowestGrade FROM frpm WHERE `District Code` = 0632640;

SELECT 
    T2.District, 
    T1.AdmFName1 AS FirstName, 
    COUNT(T2.CDSCode) AS NumSchools
FROM 
    schools AS T2 
JOIN 
    (SELECT AdmFName1, COUNT(CDSCode) AS SchoolCount FROM schools GROUP BY AdmFName1) AS T1 
ON 
    T2.DOC = T1.DOC AND T2.DOCType = T1.DOCType AND T2.County IN ('Amador', 'Madera')
WHERE 
    T2.DistrictType IN ('Unified School District', 'Elementary School District', 'High School District', 'County Office of Education')
GROUP BY 
    T2.District, T1.AdmFName1
ORDER BY 
    T1.SchoolCount DESC, T1.AdmFName1
LIMIT 2;

SELECT T1.School_Type, T1.School_Name, T1.Latitude 
FROM schools AS T1 
JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.`School Code` 
WHERE T1.State = 'CA' AND (T1.`School Type` LIKE '%Middle%' OR T2.`School Type` LIKE '%Middle%') 
ORDER BY T1.Latitude DESC 
GROUP BY T1.School_Name 
HAVING T1.Latitude = (SELECT MAX(Latitude) FROM schools AS T3 JOIN frpm AS T4 ON T3.CDSCode = T4.`School Code` WHERE T3.State = 'CA' AND (T3.`School Type` LIKE '%Middle%' OR T4.`School Type` LIKE '%Middle%'))

SELECT ROUND(SUM(NumTstTakr) / COUNT(DISTINCT cds), 2) AS avg_sat_takers
FROM satscores ss
JOIN schools sc ON ss.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE sc.County = 'Los Angeles' AND sc.StatusType = 'O' AND YEAR(sc.OpenDate) = 2007 AND sc.DOCType = 'SD'

SELECT 
    f.`County Name`, 
    COUNT(s.CDSCode) AS num_schools, 
    ROUND(AVG(f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)` * 100), 2) AS avg_free_percent, 
    ROUND(AVG(f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` * 100), 2) AS avg_FRPM_percent, 
    SUM(CASE WHEN f.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_charter_schools, 
    SUM(CASE WHEN f.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_non_charter_schools, 
    ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(s.NumTstTakr * (s.AvgScrRead + s.AvgScrMath + s.AvgScrWrite) / 3) / SUM(s.NumTstTakr), 0), 2) AS avg_SAT_score
FROM 
    frpm f
JOIN 
    schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE 
    f.`County Code` = (SELECT `County Code` FROM frpm WHERE CDSCode = '1612590125716') 
    AND f.`Enrollment (K-12)` > 500 
    AND f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` < 700
GROUP BY 
    f.`County Name`;

SELECT 
    `School Name`, 
    `Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)` AS FreeMealRate, 
    CASE 
        WHEN `Charter School (Y/N)` = 1 THEN 'Yes' 
        WHEN `Charter School (Y/N)` = 0 THEN 'No' 
        ELSE 'Unknown' 
    END AS Charter, 
    `GSserved`, 
    CASE 
        WHEN `NumTstTakr` = 0 THEN 'No SAT Data' 
        WHEN `AvgScrRead` < 500 THEN 'Below Average' 
        WHEN `AvgScrRead` BETWEEN 500 AND 550 THEN 'Average' 
        ELSE 'Above Average' 
    END AS SATPerformance 
FROM 
    frpm 
JOIN 
    schools ON frpm.`School Code` = schools.CDSCode 
JOIN 
    satscores ON schools.CDSCode = satscores.cds 
WHERE 
    `County Name` = 'Alameda' AND `Enrollment (K-12)` > 0 AND `GSserved` >= '9' 
GROUP BY 
    `School Name`, `Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`, `Charter School (Y/N)`, `GSserved`, `NumTstTakr`, `AvgScrRead` 
HAVING 
    `Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)` = (SELECT MAX(`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`) FROM frpm WHERE `County Name` = 'Alameda' AND `Enrollment (K-12)` > 0 AND `GSserved` >= '9') 
ORDER BY 
    `Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)` DESC;

SELECT 
    `School Name` AS SchoolName,
    Phone,
    Website,
    AvgScrRead,
    AvgScrMath,
    AvgScrWrite,
    CharterSchool `(Y/N)` AS Charter,
    `Enrollment (K-12)` AS K12Enrollment,
    ROUND(`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)` * 100, 2) AS FreeMealPercentage,
    (SELECT MAX(AvgScrMath) FROM satscores WHERE NumTstTakr >= 10) AS HighestMathScore,
    COALESCE((SELECT MAX(AvgScrMath) FROM satscores WHERE NumTstTakr >= 10) - AvgScrMath, 0) AS ScoreDifference
FROM 
    schools 
JOIN 
    satscores ON schools.CDSCode = satscores.cds
WHERE 
    schools.CDSCode = '7618040113118';

SELECT 
    T3.`County Name`, 
    COUNT(T3.CDSCode) AS VirtualSchoolCount, 
    MAX(T2.AvgScrRead) AS MaxAvgScrRead, 
    GROUP_CONCAT(T2.sname ORDER BY T2.AvgScrRead DESC SEPARATOR ', ') AS VirtualSchools
FROM 
    satscores AS T2
JOIN 
    schools AS T3 ON T2.cds = T3.CDSCode
JOIN 
    frpm AS T1 ON T3.CDSCode = T1.`School Code`
WHERE 
    T3.Virtual = 'Yes' AND T3.`School Type` = 'Virtual'
GROUP BY 
    T3.`County Name`
HAVING 
    T3.`School Type` = 'Virtual'
ORDER BY 
    COUNT(T3.CDSCode) DESC, MAX(T2.AvgScrRead) DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT AdmFName1, AdmLName1 
FROM schools 
WHERE County = (
    SELECT County 
    FROM schools 
    WHERE CDSCode = '1611430131177'
) 
AND CDSCode = (
    SELECT cds 
    FROM (
        SELECT cds, SUM(NumGE1500) as total 
        FROM satscores 
        GROUP BY cds 
        ORDER BY total DESC, cds ASC 
        LIMIT 1
    )
);

SELECT DISTINCT 
    `School Name` AS SchoolName,
    Street AS CampusStreet,
    City AS CampusCity,
    State AS CampusState,
    Zip AS CampusZip
FROM 
    frpm
JOIN 
    schools ON frpm.`School Code` = schools.CDSCode
WHERE 
    `School Type` IN ('High School', 'Continuation High School', 'Single School District')
    AND `County Name` = 'Los Angeles'
    AND `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 500
ORDER BY 
    SchoolName, CampusStreet, CampusCity, CampusState, CampusZip;

SELECT DISTINCT c.name, c.artist, c.isPromo 
FROM cards c 
JOIN rulings r ON c.uuid = r.uuid 
WHERE c.name IN (SELECT name FROM cards WHERE id IN (SELECT uuid FROM rulings GROUP BY uuid ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1))

SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN f.language = 'Simplified Chinese' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS percentage
FROM cards c
JOIN foreign_data f ON c.uuid = f.uuid

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.isStorySpotlight = 1 AND t.language = 'French' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM cards c
LEFT JOIN set_translations t ON c.setCode = t.setCode
WHERE c.isStorySpotlight = 1
SELECT id FROM cards WHERE duelDeck = 'a'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL AND c.cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM cards c WHERE c.layout = 'normal' AND c.setCode IN (SELECT s.code FROM sets s WHERE s.block = 'Coldsnap')

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid) 
FROM cards c 
JOIN printings p ON c.uuid = p.card_uuid 
WHERE p.promoTypes LIKE '%Brawl%' AND c.type = 'Creature'

SELECT SUM(totalSetSize) 
FROM sets 
WHERE code IN (SELECT setCode FROM set_translations GROUP BY setCode HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT translation) < 5)

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rulings WHERE uuid = (SELECT uuid FROM cards WHERE name = 'Mishra''s Factory') AND date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM rulings WHERE uuid = (SELECT uuid FROM cards WHERE name = 'Mishra''s Factory'))

SELECT frameVersion, COUNT(*) AS card_count 
FROM cards 
WHERE convertedManaCost = 0 
GROUP BY frameVersion 
HAVING frameVersion = (SELECT MAX(frameVersion) FROM cards WHERE convertedManaCost = 0)

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.frameVersion = 'normal' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.uuid) * 100 AS percentage,
    YEAR(MAX(T2.releaseDate)) AS latest_year
FROM 
    cards AS T1
JOIN 
    sets AS T2 ON T1.setCode = T2.code
WHERE 
    T1.name = 'Tarmogoyf'

SELECT 
    s1.name AS setName, 
    ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid), 2) AS percentCheapCards 
FROM 
    sets s1 
JOIN 
    cards c ON s1.code = c.setCode 
WHERE 
    (s1.releaseDate, s1.code) IN 
    (SELECT MIN(s.releaseDate), s.code FROM sets s JOIN cards c ON s.code = c.setCode WHERE c.name = 'Abyssal Horror' GROUP BY s.code) 
    OR 
    (s1.releaseDate, s1.code) IN 
    (SELECT MAX(s.releaseDate), s.code FROM sets s GROUP BY s.code) 
GROUP BY 
    s1.name;

SELECT 
    c.name, 
    c.number, 
    COUNT(fd.id) AS foreign_printings
FROM 
    cards c
JOIN 
    foreign_data fd ON c.uuid = fd.uuid
WHERE 
    c.watermark = 'Abzan'
GROUP BY 
    c.name, c.number
HAVING 
    c.number = (
        SELECT 
            MAX(c2.number) 
        FROM 
            cards c2
        WHERE 
            c2.watermark = 'Abzan'
    )
ORDER BY 
    c.number DESC

SELECT 
    s.name AS setName, 
    s.keyruneCode, 
    COUNT(fd.language) AS languageCount 
FROM 
    sets s 
LEFT JOIN 
    set_translations fd ON s.code = fd.setCode 
WHERE 
    s.releaseDate BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-12-31' 
GROUP BY 
    s.name, 
    s.keyruneCode;

SELECT artist, COUNT(*) AS illustrated_count 
FROM cards 
WHERE borderColor = 'black' 
AND mtgArenaId IS NOT NULL 
AND power >= '10'
GROUP BY artist 
HAVING illustrated_count = (SELECT MAX(illustrated_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS illustrated_count FROM cards WHERE borderColor = 'black' AND mtgArenaId IS NOT NULL AND power >= '10' GROUP BY artist))

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid) 
FROM cards c 
WHERE c.hasContentWarning = 1 AND c.isOnlineOnly = 0 AND c.availability = 'paper'

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM cards AS c 
JOIN sets AS s ON c.setCode = s.code 
WHERE c.name = 'Ancestor''s Chosen' AND s.releaseDate = (
    SELECT MAX(releaseDate) 
    FROM sets
) AND c.power > c.toughness AND c.type LIKE '%creature%';

SELECT frameVersion, COUNT(*) AS card_count 
FROM cards 
WHERE frameVersion IS NOT NULL AND availability LIKE '%Commander%' AND (hasFoil = 1 AND hasNonFoil = 1) 
GROUP BY frameVersion 
ORDER BY frameVersion DESC 
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.name, COUNT(r.uuid) AS ruling_count 
FROM cards c 
JOIN rulings r ON c.uuid = r.uuid 
WHERE c.originalType = 'Creature - Elf' 
GROUP BY c.name 
HAVING ruling_count = (SELECT MAX(ruling_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(r.uuid) AS ruling_count FROM cards c JOIN rulings r ON c.uuid = r.uuid WHERE c.originalType = 'Creature - Elf' GROUP BY c.name))

SELECT T2.frameVersion, COUNT(*) AS count FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN foreign_data AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T1.artist = 'John Avon' AND T1.hasFoil = 1 GROUP BY T2.frameVersion ORDER BY CAST(SUBSTR(T2.frameVersion, LENGTH(T2.frameVersion) - 2, 4) AS INTEGER) DESC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.setCode) 
FROM cards c 
JOIN legalities l ON c.uuid = l.uuid 
JOIN foreign_data fd ON c.uuid = fd.uuid 
WHERE c.layout = 'normal' AND l.format = 'pauper' AND fd.artist = 'Erica Yang'

SELECT T1.type, COUNT(*) AS count 
FROM cards AS T1 
JOIN foreign_data AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid 
WHERE T1.watermark = 'Boros' AND T2.language != 'English'
GROUP BY T1.type
ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT T2.watermark, COUNT(*) AS count
FROM foreign_data AS T2
JOIN cards AS T1 ON T2.uuid = T1.uuid
WHERE T2.watermark IN ('Azorius', 'Boros', 'Dimir', 'G Golgari', 'Gruul', 'Izzet', 'Orzhov', 'Rakdos', 'Selesnya', 'Simic')
GROUP BY T2.watermark
HAVING COUNT(*) = (
    SELECT MAX(COUNT(*))
    FROM foreign_data AS T2
    JOIN cards AS T1 ON T2.uuid = T1.uuid
    WHERE T2.watermark IN ('Azorius', 'Boros', 'Dimir', 'G Golgari', 'Gruul', 'Izzet', 'Orzhov', 'Rakdos', 'Selesnya', 'Simic')
    GROUP BY T2.watermark
)

SELECT T2.types, COUNT(*) AS count
FROM cards AS T1
JOIN foreign_data AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid
WHERE T1.watermark = 'Azorius' AND T2.language != 'English'
GROUP BY T2.types
ORDER BY count DESC, T2.types;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid) 
FROM cards c 
WHERE c.frameVersion LIKE '2015%' AND c.text IS NOT NULL

SELECT DISTINCT T1.name 
FROM cards AS T1 
JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid 
JOIN foreign_data AS T3 ON T1.uuid = T3.uuid 
WHERE T1.hasFoil = 1 AND T1.isPromo = 1 AND T1.frameVersion = (SELECT frameVersion FROM cards WHERE hasFoil = 1 AND isPromo = 1 AND frameVersion IN (SELECT DISTINCT frameVersion FROM cards WHERE hasFoil = 1 AND isPromo = 1 AND hasNonFoil = 1) ORDER BY CAST(SUBSTR(frameVersion, INSTR(frameVersion, '-') + 1, 4) AS INTEGER) DESC LIMIT 1)

SELECT s.name, s.releaseDate 
FROM sets s
JOIN set_translations st ON s.code = st.setCode
WHERE s.type = (SELECT type FROM sets WHERE name = 'From the Vault: Lore')
GROUP BY s.code
HAVING COUNT(st.translation) = 0
ORDER BY s.releaseDate ASC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 0

SELECT s.name, s.releaseDate 
FROM cards c 
JOIN sets s ON c.setCode = s.code 
JOIN (
    SELECT uuid, MAX(frameVersion) AS maxFrameVersion 
    FROM cards 
    GROUP BY uuid
) c2 ON c.uuid = c2.uuid AND c.frameVersion = c2.maxFrameVersion 
JOIN (
    SELECT uuid, MAX(r.date) AS maxDate 
    FROM rulings r 
    GROUP BY uuid
) r2 ON c.uuid = r2.uuid AND r.date = r2.maxDate 
WHERE c.name = 'Aven Mindcensor' 
GROUP BY s.name, s.releaseDate 
HAVING COUNT(c.printings) = (
    SELECT COUNT(*) 
    FROM cards c3 
    WHERE c3.uuid = c.uuid
);

SELECT 
    f.name AS japaneseCardName, 
    c.type AS englishCardType, 
    SUM(CASE WHEN r.uuid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rulingTotal 
FROM 
    cards c 
JOIN 
    foreign_data f ON c.uuid = f.uuid 
JOIN 
    sets s ON c.setCode = s.code 
JOIN 
    rulings r ON c.uuid = r.uuid 
WHERE 
    c.watermark = 'Boros' 
    AND f.language = 'Japanese' 
    AND s.block = 'Block A' 
GROUP BY 
    f.name, 
    c.type 
ORDER BY 
    f.name, 
    c.type;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cards WHERE power > 3 AND power <= 10

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM cards 
WHERE originalReleaseDate LIKE '2014-%' AND setCode IN (SELECT code FROM sets WHERE mtgoCode IS NOT NULL)

SELECT language, COUNT(*) AS printings
FROM foreign_data fd
JOIN cards c ON fd.uuid = c.uuid
JOIN sets s ON c.setCode = s.code
GROUP BY language
HAVING language NOT IN (SELECT translation FROM set_translations WHERE setCode NOT IN (SELECT code FROM sets WHERE type = 'core' OR type = 'expansion' OR type = 'premium'))
ORDER BY COUNT(*) ASC
LIMIT 100
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cards AS c JOIN foreign_data AS fd ON c.uuid = fd.uuid JOIN sets AS s ON c.setCode = s.code WHERE s.code = 'Coldsnap' AND fd.language = 'it'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T2.language) 
FROM cards AS T1 
JOIN foreign_data AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid 
WHERE T1.name = 'Swamp' AND T1.layout = 'land'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid) 
FROM cards c
JOIN foreign_data fd ON c.uuid = fd.uuid
WHERE c.colorIdentity = 'B' AND c.types LIKE '%Artifact%' AND LENGTH(c.colorIdentity) = LENGTH(c.colors)

SELECT 
    (SELECT AVG(CAST(SUBSTR(Name, 1, 4) - 'Student10' AS INT)) * 100 / COUNT(*) 
     FROM badges 
     WHERE Name LIKE 'Student10%') - 
    (SELECT AVG(CAST(SUBSTR(Name, 1, 4) - 'Student11' AS INT)) * 100 / COUNT(*) 
     FROM badges 
     WHERE Name LIKE 'Student11%') AS diff_percentage_points
SELECT T1.ViewCount, T1.LastEditorDisplayName FROM posts AS T1 WHERE T1.Title = 'Computer game datasets'

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM comments 
WHERE PostId IN (SELECT PostId FROM comments GROUP BY PostId HAVING COUNT(*) = 1) 
AND Score = 0;

SELECT T2.Age 
FROM users AS T2
JOIN badges AS T1 ON T2.Id = T1.UserId
WHERE T1.Name = 'Innovator' AND T2.Location LIKE '%York%'
ORDER BY T2.Reputation DESC
LIMIT 1
UNION ALL
SELECT T2.Age 
FROM users AS T2
JOIN badges AS T1 ON T2.Id = T1.UserId
WHERE T2.Location LIKE '%York%'
GROUP BY T2.Age
HAVING COUNT(T2.Id) = (
    SELECT COUNT(*) 
    FROM users AS T3
    JOIN badges AS T4 ON T3.Id = T4.UserId
    WHERE T4.Name = 'Innovator' AND T3.Location LIKE '%York%'
)
ORDER BY T2.Age;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM badges AS b JOIN users AS u ON b.UserId = u.Id WHERE u.Location = 'India' AND b.Name = 'Yearling' AND b.Date < '2014-01-01'
SELECT MIN(Id) FROM users WHERE DisplayName = 'Michael' ORDER BY CreationDate ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT 
    ROUND(AVG(T2.UpVotes), 2) AS AvgUpVotes, 
    ROUND(AVG(T1.Age), 2) AS AvgAge 
FROM 
    posts AS T1 
JOIN 
    votes AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.PostId 
JOIN 
    users AS T3 ON T1.OwnerUserId = T3.Id 
WHERE 
    T1.CreationDate BETWEEN '2012-01-01 00:00:00' AND '2012-12-31 23:59:59' 
GROUP BY 
    T3.Id 
HAVING 
    COUNT(T1.Id) > 10

SELECT 
    U.DisplayName, 
    COUNT(PH.Comment) AS CommentCount
FROM 
    posts AS P
JOIN 
    postHistory AS PH ON P.Id = PH.PostId
JOIN 
    users AS U ON PH.UserId = U.Id
WHERE 
    P.Title = 'Why square the difference instead of taking the absolute value in standard deviation?'
GROUP BY 
    U.DisplayName, 
    PH.Comment
HAVING 
    PH.Comment IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 
    CommentCount DESC

SELECT c.Segment, COUNT(DISTINCT t.CustomerID) AS CustomersWithFuel
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN `yearmonth` ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
LEFT JOIN `transactions_1k` t ON c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID
WHERE ym.Date LIKE '2013-%'
GROUP BY c.Segment
HAVING CustomersWithFuel > 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.CustomerID) 
FROM `transactions_1k` t 
JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID 
WHERE c.Segment = 'SMB' AND t.Date BETWEEN '2013-02-01' AND '2013-02-28'

SELECT T2.player_name 
FROM (
    SELECT player_api_id, AVG(finishing) as avg_finishing
    FROM Player_Attributes
    GROUP BY player_api_id
) AS T1
JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id_id
WHERE T2.height = (
    SELECT MAX(height) FROM Player
) OR T2.height = (
    SELECT MIN(height) FROM Player
)
ORDER BY avg_finishing DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * (SELECT overall_rating FROM Player_Attributes WHERE player_api_id = (SELECT player_api_id FROM Player WHERE player_name = 'Ariel Borysiuk' ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1) - (SELECT overall_rating FROM Player_Attributes WHERE player_api_id = (SELECT player_api_id FROM Player WHERE player_name = 'Paulin Puel' ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1)) / (SELECT overall_rating FROM Player_Attributes WHERE player_api_id = (SELECT player_api_id FROM Player WHERE player_name = 'Paulin Puel' ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1)), 2)

SELECT 
ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN T.defensive_work_rate = 'HIGH' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100 / COUNT(T.id), 2) 
AS defensive_high_percentage 
FROM 
(SELECT pa.player_api_id, MAX(pa.defensive_work_rate) as max_defensive_work_rate 
FROM Player_Attributes pa 
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id 
WHERE p.birthday LIKE '1991%' OR p.birthday LIKE '1992%' OR p.birthday LIKE '1993%' OR p.birthday LIKE '1994%' OR p.birthday LIKE '1995%' OR p.birthday LIKE '1996%' OR p.birthday LIKE '1997%' OR p.birthday LIKE '1998%' OR p.birthday LIKE '1999%' 
GROUP BY pa.player_api_id) T

SELECT ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN p.date = '2010-12-31' AND pa.overall_rating > 80 THEN COUNT(DISTINCT m.match_api_id) ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(DISTINCT pa.player_api_id), 2) 
FROM Player_Attributes pa 
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id 
JOIN Match m ON (pa.player_api_id IN (m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5, m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8, m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11, m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4, m.away_player_5, m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8, m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11))
WHERE p.date = '2010-12-31' AND pa.overall_rating > 80 AND m.season = '2010/2011'

SELECT ROUND(AVG(T.height), 2) AS average_height
FROM `Player` T
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON T.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE PA.defensive_work_rate = 'Medium' AND T.birthday BETWEEN '1990-01-01' AND '1995-12-31'

SELECT 
    p.player_name, 
    COUNT(m.id) AS matches_played
FROM 
    `Player` p
JOIN 
    `Match` m ON p.player_api_id = m.home_player_1 OR p.player_api_id = m.home_player_2 OR 
                 p.player_api_id = m.home_player_3 OR p.player_api_id = m.home_player_4 OR 
                 p.player_api_id = m.home_player_5 OR p.player_api_id = m.home_player_6 OR 
                 p.player_api_id = m.home_player_7 OR p.player_api_id = m.home_player_8 OR 
                 p.player_api_id = m.home_player_9 OR p.player_api_id = m.home_player_10 OR 
                 p.player_api_id = m.home_player_11 OR p.player_api_id = m.away_player_1 OR 
                 p.player_api_id = m.away_player_2 OR p.player_api_id = m.away_player_3 OR 
                 p.player_api_id = m.away_player_4 OR p.player_api_id = m.away_player_5 OR 
                 p.player_api_id = m.away_player_6 OR p.player_api_id = m.away_player_7 OR 
                 p.player_api_id = m.away_player_8 OR p.player_api_id = m.away_player_9 OR

SELECT b.bond_type, COUNT(c.bond_id) AS count 
FROM `connected` c 
JOIN `bond` b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id 
JOIN `atom` a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id 
JOIN `molecule` m ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id 
WHERE m.label IN (SELECT label FROM `molecule` WHERE label LIKE '%carcinogenic%') 
GROUP BY b.bond_type

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T2.atom_id2) 
FROM atom AS T1 
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id 
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T2.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id 
WHERE T1.element = 'Cl'

SELECT DISTINCT b.bond_id, b.molecule_id 
FROM bond b 
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id 
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id 
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id 
WHERE m.label = '+' AND a.element NOT IN (SELECT element FROM atom WHERE atom.atom_id NOT IN (SELECT c.atom_id FROM connected c WHERE c.atom_id = atom.atom_id))

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t1.atom_id) 
FROM connected AS t1 
JOIN atom AS t2 ON t1.atom_id2 = t2.atom_id 
JOIN bond AS t3 ON t1.bond_id = t3.bond_id 
JOIN atom AS t4 ON t1.atom_id = t4.atom_id 
WHERE t4.element = 'cl'

SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(c.bond_id) AS bond_count
FROM molecule m
JOIN connected c ON m.molecule_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id
WHERE a.element NOT IN (SELECT a2.element FROM atom a2 JOIN connected c2 ON a2.atom_id = c2.atom_id WHERE c2.molecule_id != m.molecule_id)
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
HAVING COUNT(c.bond_id) > 0
ORDER BY m.molecule_id

SELECT 
    m.molecule_id, 
    m.label, 
    COUNT(a.atom_id) AS num_atoms, 
    COUNT(b.bond_id) AS num_bonds, 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN a.element = 'C' THEN 1 END) AS num_carbon_atoms, 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN a.element = 'Cl' THEN 1 END) AS num_chlorine_atoms, 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.bond_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS num_carbon_touching_bonds, 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN b.bond_type IN ('double', 'triple') THEN 1 END) AS num_multiple_bonds, 
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(CASE WHEN c.bond_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) DESC, COUNT(a.atom_id) DESC, m.molecule_id ASC) AS rank
FROM 
    atom a
JOIN 
    molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
LEFT JOIN 
    connected c ON (a.atom_id, (SELECT atom_id2 FROM connected WHERE atom_id = a.atom_id AND bond_id = c.bond_id)) IN ((a.atom_id, c.atom_id2), (c.atom_id2, a.atom_id))
JOIN 
    bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE 
    a.element = 'C'
GROUP BY 
    m.molecule_id, m.label
ORDER BY 
    rank, num_atoms DESC, m.molecule_id ASC;

FROM `connected` AS c 
JOIN `atom` AS a ON c.`atom_id` = a.`atom_id` 
JOIN `atom` AS a2 ON c.`atom_id2` = a2.`atom_id` 
JOIN `molecule` AS m ON a.`molecule_id` = m.`molecule_id` 
WHERE a.`element` = 'Yttrium' AND a2.`element` = 'Hydrogen'

SELECT t1.element, COUNT(DISTINCT t3.molecule_id) AS molecule_count 
FROM atom AS t1 
JOIN connected AS t2 ON t1.atom_id = t2.atom_id 
JOIN bond AS t3 ON t2.bond_id = t3.bond_id 
WHERE t3.bond_type = 'triple' 
GROUP BY t1.element 
ORDER BY molecule_count DESC, t1.element ASC;
